title: connectNumericMenu not working with same `start` value in `items`
body:
<!--
  Thanks for participating in this project! We will try to answer as soon as possible 🙏
-->

**Describe the bug 🐛**

connectNumericMenu is not working when there are more than one items with same `start` value in `items`.

**To Reproduce 🔍**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Open `numeric-menu.stories.js`
2. Add the following story:
```js
  .add(
    'same start value',
    withHits(({ search, container, instantsearch }) => {
      search.addWidget(
        instantsearch.widgets.numericMenu({
          container,
          attribute: 'price',
          items: [
            { label: 'All' },
            { start: 1, end: 2, label: '1-2' },
            { start: 1, end: 10, label: '1-10' },
          ],
        })
      );
    })
  )
```

3. Click `1-2`.
4. `1-10` is selected instead.

**Expected behavior 💭**
`1-2` is supposed to be selected

**Screenshots 🖥**

![Kapture 2019-09-17 at 14 14 45](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/499898/65040805-88ad0a00-d955-11e9-9c10-31658b4e55c9.gif)
